objects.abstract:
Stream Control Transmission Protocol RFC2960 [2] is a multi-homed
   transport protocol.  As such, unique security threats exists that are
   addressed in various ways within the protocol itself.  This document
   attempts to detail the known security threats and there
   countermeasures as detailed in the current version of the SCTP
   Implementors guide (SCTP-IG).  It is hoped that this information will
   provide some useful background information for many of the newest
   requirements spelled out in the SCTP-IG.
objects.name: draft-stewart-tsvwg-sctpthreat
objects.title: Stream Control Transmission Protocol (SCTP) Security Threats

objects.abstract: This document describes certain security threats to SCTP.  It also describes ways to mitigate these threats, in particular by using techniques from the SCTP Specification Errata and Issues memo (RFC 4460).  These techniques are included in RFC 4960, which obsoletes RFC 2960.  It is hoped that this information will provide some useful background information for many of the newest requirements spelled out in the SCTP Specification Errata and Issues and included in RFC 4960.  This memo provides information for the Internet community.
objects.name: draft-ietf-tsvwg-sctpthreat
objects.title: Security Attacks Found Against the Stream Control Transmission Protocol (SCTP) and Current Countermeasures
